'''Rick Grendell''' is a Star Wars CCG player who played at [[2000 Death Star II Pre-Release (Normal)]] on 24 June 2000 with Endor, Hidden Forest Trail start with Careful Planning, according to David Marincic's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d944">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-06-26-d-ii-prerelease-in-normal-il-6-24-00d944/ d-ii-prerelease-in-normal-il-6-24-00], DeckTech (David "Wedge659" Marincic, 26 June 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-06-26-d-ii-prerelease-in-normal-il-6-24-00d944/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
